reviewer: OpenAI ChatGPT under Project Owner direction

review_method.scope: preliminary provenance, art-direction, technical-usability, and promotion-route review
limitations: Some assets were evaluated from File Library visual summaries plus repository records rather than an opened full-resolution binary.
No reverse-image search, provider-side verification, trademark clearance search, or legal opinion was performed.
Every exact use still requires human review of the original full-resolution binary.

required_before_exact_use: preserve the original external binary and registered SHA-256
perform human visual review against the original full-resolution binary before any use
complete a targeted third-party character, logo, trademark, likeness, signature, watermark, and substantial-similarity review
record every edit, model-input use, extraction, export, and resulting SHA-256
obtain a separate promotion decision for the exact proposed use

rights_review_baseline.notes: No prohibited uploaded inputs were reported by the Project Owner. Provider terms and owner attestation support controlled evaluation, but do not guarantee copyrightability, exclusivity, non-infringement, or public-use clearance.

similarity_review_baseline.notes: No specific protected character, franchise, celebrity, or third-party work is identified in the available records. This is not reverse-image-search evidence or a legal opinion.

quality_review_baseline.notes: Disposition and blockers are recorded for the intended production role. No physical television, controller, accessibility, or final runtime quality claim is made.
